tasks.example:build: deno run -A jsr:@marianmeres/deno-build@^2.2.0 --root example/src --entry main.ts --outdir example/dist --hash && deno run -A example/inject-bundle.ts
tasks.example:watch: deno run -A example/inject-bundle.ts --reset && deno run -A jsr:@marianmeres/deno-build@^2.2.0 --root example/src --entry main.ts --outdir example/dist --watch
tasks.npm:publish: deno run -A scripts/build-npm.ts && cd ./.npm-dist && npm publish --access=public
tasks.rp: deno task release -y && deno task publish
tasks.rpm: deno task release minor -y && deno task publish
